question.whyItMatters: Mireille empties the Inbox every Friday.

text.text: Capture everything in the Inbox, decide what matters this week, and pick a few things for Today. Views below slice the same tasks every way you need.
Three to five things. If everything is Today, nothing is.
Fifteen minutes on Friday afternoon or Monday morning.
Empty the Inbox: every item gets a status and a focus
Move finished tasks to Done and look at what is left
Check each active project has a next task
Look at the calendar for the next two weeks
Two minutes at the end of the day. A win, a lesson, a mood. Over time it shows what a good day looks like.
What is the first task tomorrow?
Focus says when you intend to act. It is separate from the due day, so a task can be due in a week but still be today’s work.
Set Repeats on a task. When you finish it, copy it forward with the next due day.
Estimates are in minutes. They help you see if Today fits in a day; they do not have to be accurate.
